rationale: the operator policy: a candidate source whose evidence is thin (probe did not surface a clear acquisition edge over plain web search) is REJECTED, not admitted-on-doubt. Admission is the exception that must be earned; Penumbra stays small and high-signal. This posture is DATA, read into the evidence packet's policy_posture; it is NOT a code constant.

auto_apply.note: Conservative floor for a FUTURE P1.5 live auto-apply. org_watch / page_watch / news_scraper / render-scrapers are EXCLUDED (their recurring post-admission fetch bypasses safe_fetch; org_watch is a turnkey people-tracker that 'delete the row' cannot un-harvest). In P1 there is NO live auto-apply at all: every admit stages to owner_review. Widening this list is a deliberate operator edit.
